{{Quote|Perats. Do you see Pekaelic's face on the obverse? I see at least twenty of them. Not a fortune, but definitely an improvement in his estate.|[[Cheriss ke Hanadi]]|<ref name="SoA">''[[X-Wing: Starfighters of Adumar]]''</ref>}}
'''Adumari credcoins''' were the common currency of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Adumar/Legends|Adumar]].<ref name="SoA" />

Credcoins were made from round metal discs<ref name="SoA" /> similar to other tangible currencies in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] like [[Wupiupi/Legends|wupiupi]],<ref name="e1vd">''[[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> and during the [[New Republic era]] they were worth slightly less than the [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|Galactic Credit Standard]].<ref name="Pilots Wanted">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20040401adumarmain|text=Adumar: Pilots Wanted|int=Adumar: Pilots Wanted}}</ref>

A denomination of credcoin in [[Cartann]] was the [[perat]], named for the ruling position of [[perator]]. In [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]] Cartannese perats bore the face of [[Pekaelic ke Teldan]], the perator at that time.<ref name="SoA" />
